title: Build Your Own Observability Agent — Knowledge Check
description: Skills, agents, agentic workflows and running them safely.

questions.title: Skill or agent
questions.content: You want Assist to follow your team's crash-loop runbook. What do you add?

options.text: A skill with the runbook and a precise description
options.explanation: A skill adds knowledge that is loaded when its description matches.
A dashboard shows data; it does not change how Assist answers.

options.text: A workflow that runs every minute
options.explanation: A workflow schedules work; it does not add knowledge.

questions.explanation: Knowledge goes in skills; jobs go in agents.

questions.title: Least privilege

options.text: Giving it no tool that writes, and running it with read-only permissions
options.explanation: Tools and permissions are enforced; instructions are only asked.

options.text: Writing 'do not change anything' in its instructions
options.explanation: Instructions alone can be ignored or worked around.

questions.explanation: Enforce limits with tools and permissions, not with prose.

questions.title: Cost
questions.content: Which schedule is the safest default for an unattended triage agent?

options.text: Every 30 minutes, on recent problems only

options.explanation: Unbounded, and it throttles AI for everyone.

options.text: Every minute over the last 7 days
options.explanation: Frequent and large: the worst of both.

questions.explanation: Limit how often it runs and how much it reads.
hints: Think of the tenant's AI request limit.

learningObjectives: Choose between a skill and an agent
